resources.string: This app contains no game data. It plays your own dump of the Korean cartridge (ADMK), which it copies into its own storage the first time. Other regions, revisions and patched ROMs are not supported.
The file could not be copied. Try again.
Leave the game?\nProgress not saved in the game is lost.
There is an autosave (%1$s).\nIt is newer than the last save made in the game. Where do you want to go on from?

A room holds four devices. On one Wi-Fi network, one device leaves the address empty and opens the room, and the others enter its address (shown on that device\'s \"Now:\" line here). With people elsewhere, everybody enters the address of a relay (acww-relay). Then talk to the gatekeeper as with DSes side by side.
Name server (for a private server, e.g. 192.0.2.10)

The game finds an access point called \"acww-kor-port\". Nintendo\'s own servers are closed: enter the name server (DNS) a private server tells you to use, one that takes unpatched games by DNS alone. The title\'s \"something else\", \"Wi-Fi settings\" has a connection test. The console\'s address and Wi-Fi user are made on this device and kept with it.
The app\'s copy of the ROM will be removed and the app will close. The save is kept.
That file is not a save (a save is 256 KB).
How it is running (include this in a report)
The last run ended with an error
Some of what you changed takes effect when the app starts again.
The 3D scene drawn by the GPU at the screen\'s own resolution, antialiased. On a device that cannot, the game runs with it off.
The 3D scene continued onto the upper screen, as one picture.
How many times the DS\'s size the scene is drawn at. Each step is much heavier.
The touch buttons hidden: everything by touching the screen.
Drag a button to move it; − and + make the one last touched smaller or larger. Back keeps the arrangement.
The town is saved aside whenever the game would let you save (every minute, and when you leave the app), and the next start asks whether to go on from it.
On: he comes after quitting without saving, as in the game. Off: he stays away.
The DS\'s local wireless (opening the gate, visiting) carried over a network to other ports.
What the game sends over Wi-Fi goes out through this device\'s network. Playing together, when on, comes first.
Copy the save out to a file, or put a file in its place (the old one is kept as acww.sav.before-import). After an import the app closes.
How much of the screen\'s resolution the 3D scene is drawn at. Lower it if the picture stutters or the device gets hot. Takes effect at once.
Keeps the game\'s threads on the device\'s fast cores. Helps where the speed is uneven or low.
Turned off by the game: three starts in a row through Vulkan never showed a picture. You can turn it on to try again.

The game draws its 3D scene 20 to 30 times a second. Scenes are made between those, for 60 pictures a second; the game runs at its own speed, and the 3D picture comes a frame or two (about 0.03 s) later. Takes effect at once.
